items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I have some of the old sheet music published by P. Ronan.

ctx.x: I know Claris Williams, he had his music publishing company, well I guess it was a publishing company then, right around the corner on Tulane. Yeah. And I used to go around there and just hang around to hear the music and what not that was coming out. He would be playing, or different fathers would be in there playing and getting a thing. Well that was right around the corner on Tulane. Yeah.
I think 1100 and something is the address. I have some of the old sheet music published by P. Ronan. Is that right? Claris Williams, like Sister Kate and all that.

I remember that from a kid. And so I got, I was so interested in music at that time, I would always be hanging around out front to hear the sounds that were coming out. So he used to give me different little things to come on in and sweep the floor or something. And the Iroquois Theater on Ramport Street at that time, that was, that was the height. If I could get to the Iroquois on Sundays, that was it. You know, I would do anything to get some money to go to the Iroquois. And they had movies? They had movies,…
